description: This file defines the Store2 class, which implements multiple interfaces related to a SQLite-backed key-value store, including cache, inspector, and limit functionalities. It includes methods for managing database integrity, backup, opening/closing the database, and CRUD operations for namespaces and keys, along with trigger creation for constraints.

classes.name: Store2
classes.description: A class implementing a SQLite-based key-value store with namespace and limit management, supporting notifications and integrity checks.

classes.name: Job
classes.description: A nested class within Store2 that dispatches value change notifications asynchronously.

methods.name: TempDirectoryCheck
methods.description: Checks and fixes the journal file directory corruption.

methods.name: IntegrityCheck
methods.description: Performs a database integrity check and marks the database as corrupt if needed.

methods.name: Backup
methods.description: Creates a backup of the database, handling corruption scenarios.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens the SQLite database, sets up schema, triggers, and constraints.

methods.name: OnValueChanged
methods.description: Notifies registered clients of a value change.
